create_rasterization_settings: create a RasterizationSettings dataclass with custom image_size, blur_radius, and faces_per_pixel parameters
build_mesh_rasterizer: build a MeshRasterizer module with cameras and RasterizationSettings to rasterize a batch of 3D meshes
rasterize_meshes_forward: run the MeshRasterizer forward pass on world-space meshes to get Fragments with pix_to_face and zbuf
transform_meshes_to_ndc: use the MeshRasterizer transform method to project world-space mesh vertices into NDC camera space
review_Fragments_namedtuple: review the Fragments NamedTuple structure containing pix_to_face, zbuf, bary_coords, and dists tensors
